name: subagent-context
description: claude context tools — Claude Code plugins for context-size awareness: subagent context reporting today; cross-session send-guarding and main-session compaction management to come.

plugins.name: subagent-context
plugins.description: Reports each subagent's context size to the orchestrating agent and warns before an overloaded subagent gets re-tasked.

plugins.name: cross-session-send-guard
plugins.description: Warns before, and can gate, a SendMessage to a large idle peer session — a cold wake replays the peer's whole transcript at full price.

plugins.name: compact-manager
plugins.description: Warns the main session as its own context fills, captures a wake packet before compaction, and reorients the session after it.
